preconditions.description: The length of txt must be between 1 and 10^5.
The length of pat must be between 1 and less than the length of txt.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= index <= len(txt) - len(pat) + 1 for index in return_value)
postconditions.description: All indices in the return value must be within the valid range of txt for pat to fit.

postconditions.expression: all(txt[index-1:index-1+len(pat)] == pat for index in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each index in the return value must correspond to the start of an occurrence of pat in txt.

postconditions.expression: return_value == [] or all(return_value[i] < return_value[i+1] for i in range(len(return_value) - 1))
postconditions.description: The return value must be an empty list or a list of indices in strictly increasing order.
